agent.finish_summary: Fixed regression in boltons/setutils.py: IndexedSet.__eq__ had an inverted comparison (`set(self) != set(other)` instead of `set(self) == set(other)`), which broke equality semantics and caused difference_update (both bulk and small variants) to misbehave, producing empty results. Corrected the operator to `==`. Verified via a temporary script covering bulk difference_update, small difference_update (unchanged case), general equality semantics (vs IndexedSet, set, mismatched sets), and self-difference_update clearing — all passed. Removed the scratch test file afterward; no test files were left in the workspace.
